description: Operating Systems & Systems Programming — Kernel internals to containerization

topics.name: Operating Systems: Kernel Types
topics.prompt: lets talk about kernel types, monolithic kernel like Linux, microkernel like Minix L4, hybrid kernel like Windows NT macOS XNU, exokernel, and tradeoffs of each design.

topics.name: System Calls: Boot Process
topics.prompt: boot process in detail, BIOS vs UEFI, POST, bootloader GRUB, kernel loading, initramfs, init process systemd, and runlevels vs systemd targets.

topics.name: Operating Systems: System Calls
topics.prompt: system calls, user mode vs kernel mode transition, syscall instruction, system call table, fork exec wait open read write close mmap ioctl, and how glibc wraps syscalls.

topics.name: System Calls: Interrupt Handling
topics.prompt: interrupts in OS, hardware interrupts IRQ, software interrupts traps, interrupt vector table, ISR interrupt service routine, top-half vs bottom-half processing, and interrupt latency.

topics.name: Operating Systems: Process States and PCB
topics.prompt: process states new ready running waiting terminated, process control block PCB contents, process state transitions, and how the OS manages the process table.

topics.name: System Calls: Context Switching
topics.prompt: context switching mechanism, saving and restoring registers, PCB swap, context switch overhead measurement, hardware vs software context switch support, and reducing context switch cost.

topics.name: Operating Systems: Process Creation
topics.prompt: process creation with fork, vfork, clone, posix_spawn, copy-on-write optimization in fork, exec family of functions, and how fork+exec pattern works in shells.

topics.name: System Calls: Orphan and Zombie Processes
topics.prompt: orphan processes adopted by init, zombie processes, wait and waitpid to reap children, SIGCHLD signal, process groups, sessions, and daemon process creation.

topics.name: Operating Systems: CPU Scheduling FCFS SJF RR
topics.prompt: CPU scheduling algorithms, FCFS first come first served, SJF shortest job first, SRTF shortest remaining time first, Round Robin with time quantum, and their comparison.

topics.name: System Calls: Priority and Multilevel Scheduling
topics.prompt: priority scheduling, aging to prevent starvation, multilevel queue scheduling, multilevel feedback queue, and how modern OS combine multiple scheduling strategies.

topics.name: Operating Systems: CFS Linux Scheduler
topics.prompt: Linux CFS completely fair scheduler, virtual runtime vruntime, red-black tree of tasks, nice values, scheduling latency, min_granularity, and how CFS achieves fairness.

topics.name: System Calls: Real-Time Scheduling
topics.prompt: real-time scheduling, hard vs soft real-time, EDF earliest deadline first, RM rate monotonic, priority inversion problem, priority inheritance protocol, and PREEMPT_RT patch.

topics.name: Operating Systems: User Threads vs Kernel Threads
topics.prompt: user-level threads vs kernel-level threads, many-to-one one-to-one many-to-many threading models, POSIX threads pthreads API, and thread creation overhead comparison.

topics.name: System Calls: Thread Pools and Green Threads
topics.prompt: thread pools, worker threads, task queues, green threads, fibers, coroutines as lightweight threading, Go goroutines, and M:N threading model.

topics.name: Operating Systems: Mutex and Semaphore
topics.prompt: mutex mutual exclusion, binary semaphore vs counting semaphore, mutex vs semaphore differences, ownership, priority inheritance, and implementation using atomic operations.

topics.name: System Calls: Spinlock and Read-Write Lock
topics.prompt: spinlocks, when to use spinlock vs mutex, ticket locks, MCS locks, read-write locks readers-writer lock, and performance implications of lock granularity.

topics.name: Operating Systems: Condition Variables and Monitors
topics.prompt: condition variables, wait signal broadcast, monitors as synchronization construct, Mesa vs Hoare semantics, spurious wakeups, and producer-consumer with condition variables.

topics.name: System Calls: Futex
topics.prompt: futex fast userspace mutex in Linux, combining userspace atomic and kernel wait queue, futex_wait futex_wake, how pthreads mutex is built on futex, and PI-futex for priority inheritance.

topics.name: Operating Systems: RCU Read-Copy-Update
topics.prompt: RCU read-copy-update synchronization in Linux kernel, read-side critical sections without locks, grace periods, synchronize_rcu, call_rcu, and applications in kernel data structures.

topics.name: System Calls: Lock-Free and Wait-Free
topics.prompt: lock-free algorithms, CAS compare-and-swap, LL/SC load-linked store-conditional, ABA problem, Michael-Scott lock-free queue, wait-free algorithms, and progress guarantees.

topics.name: Operating Systems: Deadlock Conditions
topics.prompt: deadlock, four necessary conditions mutual exclusion hold-and-wait no-preemption circular-wait, resource allocation graph, and deadlock examples in real systems.

topics.name: System Calls: Deadlock Prevention and Avoidance
topics.prompt: deadlock prevention by breaking one of four conditions, deadlock avoidance with Banker's algorithm, safe and unsafe states, and why Banker's algorithm is impractical for large systems.

topics.name: Operating Systems: Deadlock Detection and Recovery
topics.prompt: deadlock detection using wait-for graph, cycle detection, deadlock recovery by process termination or resource preemption, and livelock vs starvation.

topics.name: System Calls: Priority Inversion
topics.prompt: priority inversion problem, Mars Pathfinder incident, priority inheritance protocol, priority ceiling protocol, and how real-time OS handle priority inversion.

topics.name: Operating Systems: Contiguous Memory Allocation
topics.prompt: contiguous memory allocation, fixed vs variable partitioning, first-fit best-fit worst-fit algorithms, external fragmentation, internal fragmentation, and compaction.

topics.name: System Calls: Paging
topics.prompt: paging, logical vs physical address, page number and offset, page table, page table base register, valid/invalid bit, and how paging eliminates external fragmentation.

topics.name: Operating Systems: Segmentation
topics.prompt: segmentation, segment table, base and limit registers, segmentation with paging, segmentation fault, and comparison of paging vs segmentation.

topics.name: System Calls: Page Replacement Algorithms
topics.prompt: page replacement algorithms, FIFO, optimal (Belady's), LRU, clock algorithm second-chance, NRU not recently used, LFU, MFU, and Belady's anomaly with FIFO.

topics.name: Operating Systems: Thrashing and Working Set
topics.prompt: thrashing, causes of thrashing, working set model, working set window, page fault frequency approach, and how OS detect and recover from thrashing.

topics.name: System Calls: Demand Paging and Copy-on-Write
topics.prompt: demand paging, page fault handling steps, effective access time with page faults, copy-on-write fork optimization, and prepaging strategies.

topics.name: Operating Systems: Virtual Memory Deep Dive
topics.prompt: virtual memory implementation, multi-level page tables, inverted page tables, TLB fully-associative set-associative, ASID PCID, TLB shootdown in multiprocessor, and swapping.

topics.name: System Calls: Memory-Mapped Files
topics.prompt: memory-mapped files with mmap, private vs shared mapping, MAP_ANONYMOUS, msync, munmap, and how databases use mmap for file I/O optimization.

topics.name: Operating Systems: OOM Killer
topics.prompt: Linux OOM out of memory killer, oom_score calculation, oom_score_adj, overcommit settings vm.overcommit_memory, and strategies to prevent OOM killing critical processes.

topics.name: System Calls: ASLR and Memory Protection
topics.prompt: ASLR address space layout randomization, KASLR kernel ASLR, stack canaries, NX no-execute bit, W^X write XOR execute, and how these protect against buffer overflow exploits.

topics.name: Operating Systems: VFS Virtual File System
topics.prompt: virtual file system VFS layer in Linux, superblock inode dentry file objects, VFS operations, how VFS abstracts multiple filesystems, and mounting.

topics.name: System Calls: Inode and Directory Structure
topics.prompt: inode structure, direct indirect double-indirect triple-indirect blocks, directory entries, hard links vs soft links symbolic links, and inode number.

topics.name: Operating Systems: File Allocation Methods
topics.prompt: file allocation methods, contiguous allocation, linked allocation, indexed allocation FAT, comparison of each method, and how real file systems combine approaches.

topics.name: System Calls: ext4 File System
topics.prompt: ext4 filesystem, extents vs block mapping, journaling journal write-ahead log, delayed allocation, multiblock allocation, online defragmentation, and ext4 vs ext3 improvements.

topics.name: Operating Systems: ZFS and Btrfs
topics.prompt: ZFS filesystem, copy-on-write, checksumming, snapshots, RAID-Z levels, ZFS ARC cache, deduplication, Btrfs comparison, subvolumes, and when to use each.

topics.name: System Calls: Journaling File Systems
topics.prompt: journaling in file systems, write-ahead logging, journal modes ordered writeback journal, crash recovery, log-structured file systems LFS, and WAFL.

topics.name: Operating Systems: I/O Multiplexing select poll epoll
topics.prompt: I/O multiplexing, select limitations, poll improvements, epoll in Linux edge-triggered vs level-triggered, kqueue in BSD/macOS, and scalability comparison.

topics.name: System Calls: io_uring
topics.prompt: io_uring async I/O in Linux, submission queue and completion queue, SQE CQE, io_uring_setup, kernel-side polling SQPOLL, registered buffers, and comparison with epoll and aio.

topics.name: Operating Systems: I/O Schedulers
topics.prompt: block I/O layer, I/O schedulers in Linux, CFQ completely fair queuing, deadline scheduler, BFQ budget fair queuing, mq-deadline, none for NVMe, and choosing the right scheduler.

topics.name: System Calls: Pipes and FIFOs
topics.prompt: pipes in Unix, pipe syscall, unnamed pipes, named pipes FIFOs, pipe capacity, pipe atomicity guarantees, and implementing shell pipelines.

topics.name: Operating Systems: Message Queues
topics.prompt: IPC message queues, System V message queues msgget msgsnd msgrcv, POSIX message queues mq_open mq_send mq_receive, comparison, and when to use message queues vs pipes.

topics.name: System Calls: Shared Memory
topics.prompt: shared memory IPC, System V shmget shmat shmdt, POSIX shm_open mmap, synchronization requirements, and performance advantage of shared memory over other IPC.

topics.name: Operating Systems: Sockets IPC
topics.prompt: sockets for IPC, Unix domain sockets AF_UNIX vs network sockets AF_INET, socket types SOCK_STREAM SOCK_DGRAM, socketpair, and performance comparison with pipes.

topics.name: System Calls: Signals
topics.prompt: Unix signals, signal types SIGTERM SIGKILL SIGINT SIGSEGV SIGCHLD, signal handling sigaction, signal masks, async-signal-safe functions, and real-time signals.

topics.name: Operating Systems: Linux Namespaces
topics.prompt: Linux namespaces, PID namespace, mount namespace, network namespace, user namespace, UTS namespace, IPC namespace, cgroup namespace, and how containers use namespaces.

topics.name: System Calls: Cgroups
topics.prompt: cgroups control groups v1 and v2, resource limiting CPU memory I/O, cgroup hierarchy, systemd integration, and how Docker and Kubernetes use cgroups.

topics.name: Operating Systems: Containers and Docker
topics.prompt: container technology, how Docker works using namespaces cgroups overlayfs, container images, layers, union filesystems, runc containerd, and containers vs virtual machines.

topics.name: System Calls: SELinux and AppArmor
topics.prompt: mandatory access control MAC, SELinux security-enhanced Linux, SELinux modes enforcing permissive disabled, AppArmor profile-based, and comparison of SELinux vs AppArmor.

topics.name: Operating Systems: seccomp
topics.prompt: seccomp secure computing mode in Linux, seccomp-bpf filter mode, restricting system calls, how Docker and Chrome use seccomp, and writing seccomp filters.

topics.name: System Calls: eBPF
topics.prompt: eBPF extended Berkeley Packet Filter, eBPF programs for tracing networking security, BPF verifier, BPF maps, bpftrace, BCC tools, and how eBPF enables observability without kernel modules.

topics.name: Operating Systems: Kernel Modules
topics.prompt: Linux kernel modules, insmod rmmod modprobe, module_init module_exit, kernel space programming, printk, and how device drivers are implemented as kernel modules.

topics.name: System Calls: proc and sys Filesystems
topics.prompt: proc filesystem, process information in /proc/pid, /proc/cpuinfo meminfo, sysfs /sys, sysctl for kernel parameters, and tuning kernel via proc and sys.

topics.name: Operating Systems: Tracing and Profiling
topics.prompt: Linux tracing and profiling tools, strace for syscall tracing, ltrace for library calls, perf for performance profiling, ftrace, and flame graphs for CPU profiling.

topics.name: System Calls: Kernel Crash Analysis
topics.prompt: kernel crash analysis, kdump mechanism, crash utility, analyzing kernel oops and panics, core dumps, dmesg, and kernel debugging with KGDB.

topics.prompt: Let's build a kernel extension that extends RCU to synchronize across nodes in a multi-cluster environment, ensuring consistent visibility of data structures.

topics.name: Dynamic Promotion of 4KB Pages to 2MB Huge Pages During Demand Paging
topics.prompt: Let's design a kernel module that promotes 4KB pages to 2MB huge pages on demand, minimizing TLB shootdowns. What data structures, synchronization primitives, and TLB flush strategies should we use?

topics.name: Lock-Free B-Tree for Concurrent Page Table Management
topics.prompt: Let's build a lock-free B-tree to manage page table entries, supporting concurrent lookups and insertions. How do we handle node splitting, concurrency, and memory reclamation in the kernel context?

topics.name: Hybrid LRU-Clock Page Replacement for NUMA-Aware Systems
topics.prompt: Let's develop a page replacement algorithm that combines LRU hints with the Clock algorithm, optimized for NUMA locality. How do we maintain per-node LRU lists and integrate with the existing swapper?

topics.name: Hardware Performance Counter-Driven Memory Bandwidth Throttling
topics.prompt: Let's create a kernel module that monitors memory bandwidth via hardware performance counters and throttles processes when thresholds are exceeded. What scheduling hooks and counter interfaces should we use?

topics.name: Kernel-Mode Zero-Knowledge Proof Verification for Credential Authentication
topics.prompt: Let's implement a kernel module that verifies zk-SNARK proofs for credential authentication without exposing secrets. How do we integrate with the authentication stack and ensure constant-time operations?

topics.name: Lock-Free Reference Counting with RCU in the Linux Kernel
topics.prompt: Let's design and implement a lock-free reference counting mechanism using RCU primitives in the Linux kernel, ensuring correctness under concurrent updates.

topics.name: NUMA-Aware Slab Allocator with Dynamic Tuning
topics.prompt: Let's build a kernel module that extends the slab allocator to be NUMA-aware, dynamically tuning cache sizes based on memory locality and workload patterns.

topics.name: Zero-Copy GPU Buffer Page Fault Handler
topics.prompt: Let's implement a custom page fault handler for memory-mapped GPU buffers that achieves zero-copy transfer between user space and GPU memory, handling synchronization and caching correctly.

topics.name: SIMD-Accelerated Cryptographic Hash Kernel Module
topics.prompt: Let's develop a kernel module exposing a cryptographic hash function that leverages SIMD intrinsics for speed, interfacing via ioctl and ensuring thread safety.

topics.name: Work-Stealing Scheduler for Heterogeneous CPU/GPU Cores
topics.prompt: Let's design a kernel scheduler that implements a work-stealing algorithm to balance tasks across heterogeneous CPU and GPU cores, considering affinity and power constraints.

topics.name: Design and Implement a Lock-Free Slab Allocator with Per-CPU Caches
topics.prompt: Let's discuss how to build a lock-free slab allocator in the kernel that uses per-CPU caches and atomic compare-and-swap operations for allocation and deallocation.

topics.name: Implement an Adaptive LRU Page Replacement Algorithm in the Kernel's Virtual Memory Subsystem
topics.prompt: Let's explore how to implement an adaptive LRU page replacement algorithm that dynamically adjusts its threshold based on page fault rates in the kernel's virtual memory manager.

topics.name: Develop a Kernel Module for NUMA-Aware Scheduling with Workload Migration
topics.prompt: Let's design a kernel module that implements NUMA-aware scheduling, including workload migration policies that consider memory locality and CPU affinity.

topics.name: Create a Kernel-Level Tracing Framework for Power-Aware Scheduling Using eBPF
topics.prompt: Let's build a kernel-level tracing framework that collects power consumption metrics and feeds them into a power-aware scheduler via eBPF programs.

topics.name: Implement a Real-Time Scheduler with Priority Inheritance and Deadline Monotonic Scheduling
topics.prompt: Let's discuss implementing a real-time scheduler that supports priority inheritance and deadline monotonic scheduling, ensuring no priority inversion and meeting hard deadlines.

topics.name: Optimizing the Linux Networking Stack: BPF-based Packet Classification
topics.prompt: Describe the design considerations for implementing a BPF-based packet classifier that leverages the Linux networking stack's TC flower engine, including the trade-offs between TC action and action affinity.

topics.name: Designing a Memory-Mapped File System using the Linux VFS Layer
topics.prompt: Explain how to implement a memory-mapped file system that leverages the Linux VFS layer, including the necessary modifications to the VFS inode operations and the use of page fault handlers.

topics.name: Implementing a Real-Time Scheduling Algorithm using the Linux CFS
topics.prompt: Discuss the design and implementation of a real-time scheduling algorithm that utilizes the Linux Completely Fair Scheduler (CFS), including the necessary modifications to the CFS's time slice allocation and the use of dynamic priority adjustments.

topics.name: Kernel-Level Security: Designing an IOMMU-based DMA Protection System
topics.prompt: Describe the design and implementation of an IOMMU-based DMA protection system that leverages the Linux IOMMU API, including the necessary modifications to the IOMMU's mapping and unmapping operations and the use of DMA protection keys.

topics.name: Optimizing the Linux Page Cache using a B-TREE-based Indexing Scheme
topics.prompt: Explain the design and implementation of a B-TREE-based indexing scheme for the Linux page cache, including the necessary modifications to the page cache's lookup and insertion operations and the use of B-TREE node splitting and merging.
